name: Gimmighoul

attacks.name: Continuous Coin Toss
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavor:
It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it
gets left in shop corners since no one realizes
it’s actually a Pokémon.
